support_claim: Parallel naming across CRM and billing does not establish identity, and unresolved_preservation propositions preserve ambiguity about which legal entity is the contracting party.

propositions.proposition: CRM account NBA-102 is recorded under the name "Northbridge Analytics".
propositions.relevance: Characterizes the left referent crm:NBA-102 as the CRM record labeled "Northbridge Analytics".

propositions.proposition: Billing invoices list the billed name as "Northbridge Analytics Inc."
propositions.relevance: Characterizes the right referent billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc. as the name used on billing documents.

propositions.proposition: Sales uses the short name "Northbridge Analytics" while billing and the MSA use "Northbridge Analytics Inc."
propositions.relevance: Documents parallel naming across commercial functions but does not establish that crm:NBA-102 and the billing name denote the same legal counterparty.

propositions.proposition: A 2024 credit check returned a Wyoming LLC named "Northbridge Analytics LLC".
propositions.relevance: Introduces an additional registry entity as a live candidate for the contracting party, preserving ambiguity about which legal entity is involved.

propositions.proposition: Legal has not determined which registry entity is the contracting party.
propositions.relevance: Explicitly records that identity among candidate legal entities—including those tied to the CRM and billing names—cannot be established from available evidence.

propositions.proposition: The registry link should be treated as unresolved.
propositions.relevance: Direct instruction to preserve unresolved status rather than close the identity relation between crm:NBA-102 and billing:Northbridge Analytics Inc.
